intro: The needle on the seismograph has started drawing letters. The observatory has twelve hours before the mountain says whatever it is trying to say.
echo: The damage spreads out in rings from a single point on the surface.

puzzles.title: Ring Of Fire
puzzles.flavor: Everything came out of the wash with a little something extra. Unlucky for some, and the same distance either way.

partials.2ecbbf6730fcab91a79f3656ae0972c36e036855: You've decoded it, but it's not finished. One more layer.

hints: Each jumble is almost a word from this round, but with a letter to spare. Which letter, every time? And if what you get still isn't a word, reread the flavour text.

puzzles.title: Pahoehoe
puzzles.flavor: Every word ran into itself. The little numbers know where to look. Half a turn of the wheel and you'd have it.

partials.f22f37fa2fbdc29093c206cd5413fa88ec4dd784: You've decoded it, but it's not finished. One more layer.

hints: Two symbols, no spaces, and a letter count. Which old code is it, and which word from this round fits each line? And if what you get still isn't a word, reread the flavour text.

puzzles.title: Hot Spot
puzzles.flavor: Knock, knock. Pause. Knock knock knock.
hints: Always two numbers, never more than five. How would two prisoners spell through a wall with a 5×5 grid?

puzzles.title: Tephra
puzzles.flavor: It never travels in a straight line, and neither does the truth.

blocks.text: The knight sets out from h7: Ng5 Ne4 Nc3 Na2 Nb4 Na6 Nc5.

hints: Those are chess moves. Which squares does the piece land on, and what's written there?

puzzles.title: Plate Boundary
puzzles.flavor: Everyone here counts differently. The little number says how. Unlucky for some, and the same distance either way.

partials.6a4023ba92ad02dca690f33e05505ac8897f4e1a: You've decoded it, but it's not finished. One more layer.

hints: The subscript is a base. Once everything is in ordinary decimal, what range are the numbers in? And if what you get still isn't a word, reread the flavour text.

meta.title: Meta: Seismograph
hints: Every entry has two numbers. What in this round is numbered, and what could the second number count?
